verdict.rationale: Abacum documents its own group-based role assignment for managing user permissions across the workspace (abacum-docs-12), which covers the scoped-access side. It also documents investor/board reporting where the deck and narrative build from live actuals (abacum-docs-8, abacum-docs-7). However, no evidence shows dashboards or reports being shared with board members or teammates under those scoped permissions. Missing for 10: a documented dashboard/report sharing mechanism, board or external viewer access with per-report scoping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
